hook.text: For every kilogram of shrimp caught by trawl, up to 10 kg of other marine life is killed and discarded.

buildup.text: Bycatch includes sea turtles, dolphins, sharks, seabirds, and juvenile fish—species not targeted by the fishery.

discovery.text: An estimated 40% of global catch is bycatch—about 38 million tons of marine life wasted each year.

twist.text: Turtle excluder devices and circle hooks dramatically reduce bycatch—but enforcement is spotty.

climax.text: Albatross populations have crashed 70% due to longline fishing bycatch—hooked while diving for bait.

punchline.text: We waste nearly half of what we pull from the sea.

quiz.question: What percentage of global catch is bycatch?
